description: This file defines the interface for WiFi EndPoint WPS parameters and functions, including a class 'hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_WPS' with methods to get WPS enable status, supported configuration methods, and enabled configuration methods. It includes external headers and declares class members and methods related to WPS configuration.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_WPS
classes.description: Class providing interface to WiFi EndPoint WPS parameters and operations, including singleton management and WPS configuration retrieval.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_WPS_Enable
methods.description: Retrieves whether WPS is enabled for this WiFi endpoint.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_WPS_ConfigMethodsSupported
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported WPS configuration methods.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_WPS_ConfigMethodsEnabled
methods.description: Checks which WPS configuration methods are enabled on the device.
